body_lead: AI Clinic In Andhra Pradesh To Deliver 60 Health Test Reports In Just 60 Seconds The system uses artificial intelligence to conduct a facial scan that analyses pulse signals and subtle changes in the face Mangalagiri/Tadepalli: An AI-powered wellness clinic at the Urban Primary Health Centre in Indira Nagar, Mangalagiri, is set to provide digital reports for up to 60 different health tests within 60 seconds.
